## RE:volution Mod v2.12.2

### Added

- Pets Context Slots, pet card interactions, Awakening and server-authoritative snapshots.
- Aura Slot foundation, equip/unequip, crafting and unlock-aware HUD shortcut.
- Mastery Run foundation, five independent progression branches, permanent ranks and Mastery Tier.
- Ordinary and Mastery Reset premium preservation options.
- Location reset return handling and administrative stage access diagnostics.

### Fixed

- Allow ordinary stage progression without an active Mastery Run.
- Preserve already unlocked stages when starting a Mastery Run.
- Reset temporary stage progress while retaining permanent and historical grants.
- Guard premium crystal deduction and Reset application against duplicate requests.
- Improve Pets modal interactions, Aura unlock refresh and background blur parity.
- Preserve higher-tier standard runes and upgrades under selective non-premium Reset.

### Other

- Target runtime: Minecraft 1.12.2 / Forge 14.23.5.2859 / Java 8.
- Do not automatically classify historical stage grants or migrate production MongoDB.
- Old binary rollback compatibility after new persistence writes is not assumed. Take consistent MongoDB and world backups and test restore in isolation before future production deployment.
- Full Multiplayer QA remains deferred by owner decision.
- This GitHub Release does not deploy PROD Docker, modify PROD MongoDB, or change the PROD Client manifest.

### Download

Download `RE-volution-2.12.2.jar` from the release assets after publication.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v2.12.1...v2.12.2
